verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man’s name upon his rod.
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e toma deles uma vara para cada casa paterna de todos os seus príncipes, segundo as casas de seus pais, doze varas; e escreve o nome de cada um sobre a sua vara.
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel that they are to give you rods, one for every family, for every chief, the head of his father's house, making twelve rods; let every man's name be placed on his rod.

verses.en: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
verses.pt: O nome de Arão escreverás sobre a vara de Levi; porque cada cabeça das casas de seus pais terá uma vara.
verses.en_web: You shall write Aaron’s name on the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.
verses.en_bbe: And let Aaron's name be placed on the rod of Levi: for there is to be one rod for the head of every family.

verses.en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.pt: E as porás na tenda da revelação, perante o testemunho, onde venho a vós.
verses.en_web: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.
verses.en_bbe: And let them be stored up in the Tent of meeting, in front of the ark of witness where I come to you.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that the man’s rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
verses.pt: Então brotará a vara do homem que eu escolher; assim farei cessar as murmurações dos filhos de Israel contra mim, com que murmuram contra vós.
verses.en_web: It shall happen, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”
verses.en_bbe: And the rod of that man who is marked out by me for myself will have buds on it; so I will put a stop to the outcries which the children of Israel make to me against you.

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.pt: Falou, pois, Moisés aos filhos de Israel, e todos os seus príncipes deram-lhe varas, cada príncipe uma, segundo as casas de seus pais, doze varas; e entre elas estava a vara de Arão.
verses.en_web: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses gave these orders to the children of Israel, and all their chiefs gave him rods, one for the head of every family, making twelve rods: and Aaron's rod was among them.

verses.en: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.
verses.pt: E Moisés depositou as varas perante o Senhor na tenda do testemunho.
verses.en_web: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the Tent of the Testimony.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses put the rods before the Lord in the Tent of witness.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
verses.pt: Sucedeu, pois, no dia seguinte, que Moisés entrou na tenda do testemunho, e eis que a vara de Arão, pela casa de Levi, brotara, produzira gomos, rebentara em flores e dera amêndoas maduras.
verses.en_web: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.
verses.en_bbe: Now on the day after, Moses went into the Tent of witness; and he saw that Aaron's rod, the rod of the house of Levi, had put out buds, and was covered with buds and flowers and fruit.

verses.en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
verses.pt: Então Moisés trouxe todas as varas de diante do Senhor a todos os filhos de Israel; e eles olharam, e tomaram cada um a sua vara.
verses.en_web: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses took out all the rods from before the Lord, and gave them back to the children of Israel: and they saw them, and every man took his rod.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
verses.pt: Então o Senhor disse a Moisés: Torna a pôr a vara de Arão perante o testemunho, para se guardar por sinal contra os filhos rebeldes; para que possas fazer acabar as suas murmuraçoes contra mim, a fim de que não morram.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their murmurings against me, that they not die.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Put Aaron's rod back in front of the ark of witness, to be kept for a sign against this false-hearted people, so that you may put a stop to their outcries against me, and death may not overtake them.

verses.en: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.pt: Assim fez Moisés; como lhe ordenara o Senhor, assim fez.
verses.en_web: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
verses.en_bbe: This Moses did: as the Lord gave orders, so he did.

verses.en: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
verses.pt: Então disseram os filhos de Israel a Moisés: Eis aqui, nós expiramos, perecemos, todos nós perecemos.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel said to Moses, Truly, destruction has come on us; an evil fate has overtaken us all.

verses.en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
verses.pt: Todo aquele que se aproximar, sim, todo o que se aproximar do tabernáculo do Senhor, morrerá; porventura pereceremos todos?
verses.en_web: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”
verses.en_bbe: Death will overtake everyone who comes near, who comes near the House of the Lord: are we all to come to destruction?
